title: SpaceX leases Colossus 2 compute to Reflection AI in $6.3B deal
summary: Reflection AI will pay $150M a month through 2029 for Nvidia GB300 capacity at SpaceX's Colossus 2 data center.
reason: Large compute commitment to an open-weights lab; incremental.

title: OpenAI launches gated GPT-5.5-Cyber and 'Patch the Planet' program
summary: OpenAI released a cybersecurity-tuned model to vetted defenders and, with Trail of Bits and HackerOne, a program for AI-found open-source vulnerability fixes.
reason: Specialised cyber capability with access controls; incremental.

title: Five Eyes agencies warn frontier AI will transform cyberattacks 'within months'
summary: CISA, NSA and their UK, Canadian, Australian and New Zealand counterparts jointly warned frontier models will reshape offensive and defensive cyber capabilities: 'The timeline is not years, it is months.'
reason: Joint intelligence warning of near-term AI-enabled cyber escalation.
